text:
elaine: Quick brainstorm  propose a single 60-min hands-on webinar called 'Inference Workshop: From Bench to Runbook' aimed at infra/platform engineers. Focus: one reproducible bench, one live routing failover, and a tidy runbook + lab repo. Keep CTA = 'Get the lab repo + bench CSV'. Thoughts?

sam: Sounds good. Recommend 30m demo (bench + quick lab), 20m resilience demo (routing + failover), 10m Q. I can own the routing demo. Need an exact host cue for the intentional failover.

nuha: I'll do the bench narrative. Plan: 4 slides with numbers (q8 vs fp16 per-token, batching impact, KV cache effect, Dedicated vs hosted delta). I'll attach a small CSV and 3 eval prompts. ETA Wed.

pete: Ops checklist: reserve a tiny Dedicated pool for a 90m rehearsal, enable anonymized traffic replay, pre-provision test API keys, enable captions. I'll write the runbook with exact commands and the log-stream URL.

ivana: For leads, propose tagging: `iw.session=main`, `interest=cost|routing|lab`, `demo_request=true|false`. Nurture path: immediate repo email + follow-up segmented by interest at 3 days and 10 days. Also add utm params.

elaine: Example tag snippet to share with sales/dev:
```
event: inference_workshop
session_tag: iw.session
interest_taxonomy: [cost, routing, lab]
lead_props: [utm_source, campaign, demo_request]
```
Rehearsal cadence: full dress 1 week prior, short smoke 1h prior, host tech check 20m before. Host script must include exact failover line. Speakers confirm by EOD Fri.

sam: I'll pair with @pete on the runbook. Demo snippets I want included:
```
# run burst bench
redwood-cli bench run --model redwood-medium-q8 --profile burst --tokens 512
# flip routing to fallback
redwood-cli routing set --policy fallback-to-small --latency-ms 120
```
Also include where logs stream and how to revert.

pete: Runbook will have a "Failover Cue" section with exact phrasing: "Switching to fallback to protect latency targets  demo continues." I'll add rollback commands and infra contacts.

nuha: I'll push bench CSV and the 3 eval prompts to the marketing drive by Wed and a 3-slide bench summary for the landing page.

ivana: I'll draft the RSVP page copy and the two nurture email templates (cost + resilience tracks). Action items: elaine = landing + promo by Tue, nuha = bench assets Wed, sam+pete = runbook Mon before rehearsal, ivana = RSVP + nurture Tue. I'll send calendar placeholders now. :rocket:

rsvp-bot: calendar: placeholder created for 'Inference Workshop: From Bench to Runbook' by elaine. Reminders set (48h, 30m).

elaine: Perfect. Sending invites and a short host script now. Please ping here with any blockers.
